NOTE, DISCOVERED AFTER THIS RUN: -BuildOnly only builds the Docker image (a plain COPY layer) and never runs the Docusaurus site build inside it, so this check does not exercise Markdown link resolution and passing it is not evidence the site actually builds. It is retained here for what it does check (the image itself); the real build is the next entry.

gates.name: docker run ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template:latest Invoke-DocsBuild (the actual CI invocation, run locally)
gates.detail: First run, at commit 994a53f: Error: MDX compilation failed for file "/template/docs/guide.md" — Cause: Markdown link with URL `../../design/20-contract.md` in source file "docs/guide.md" (84:14) couldn't be resolved. Make sure it references a local Markdown file that exists within the current plugin. This surfaced first via the pushed PR's CI check 'Verify Documentation Build' (Wait-PullRequestCheck against 994a53f), then reproduced locally by running the docs-template image's real Invoke-DocsBuild command instead of docs.ps1 -BuildOnly. Root cause: the Docusaurus site only overlays docs/ into the build image; design/ is not part of that tree, so the six relative links the regeneration wrote (../../design/20-contract.md, ../../design/10-design.md) cannot resolve there even though they resolve fine on GitHub. Fixed at 05fed3f by switching those six links to the github.com blob URLs docs/docs/*.md already uses elsewhere for the same files (e.g. observability.md, implementation-plan.md). Re-run after the fix (see next entry) passed.
